description: Lock bCOOK as collateral so you can `borrow` COOK against it. One transaction: supplies the bCOOK to its reserve, deposits the minted abCOOK shares into your obligation (created on first use). `amount` is in bCOOK. Set `useHeldShares` to deposit abCOOK you already hold instead of supplying new bCOOK. Collateral earns the bCOOK supply APR while locked. Simulates first. Requires a signer: COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY locally, or in external-signer mode this returns `needs_signature` for the user's wallet to sign (see submit_signed_tx).

amount.description: UI amount of bCOOK to lock as collateral

asset.description: collateral asset; only needed if more than one reserve is collateral-enabled

useHeldShares.description: deposit share tokens already in the wallet instead of supplying new bCOOK

name: deposit_collateral
title: Deposit collateral on Aera
